items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: Well, I have told Tony and them talking about Munster.

ctx.x: Right by the ballpark. Yeah. Well, I have told Tony and them talking about Munster. I thought it was up in Campison somewhere. I didn't know where that was Munster. I always thought that was the Lions Club. They own that club. Yeah.

Well, that's right by home plate there. Yeah. Where you used to go and meet. Right. So many different guys I want to ask you about. You never did tell me much about Billy and the Dee and John. Well, I can tell you they were pretty nice fellas, people to work with.
